+"""Chained includes."""
+
+import os
+
+from lamina.errors import IncludeError
+
+
+def resolve_chained_include(base_dir: str, name: str, root: str, *, skip: list[str] | None = None) -> str:
+    """Resolve a chained include relative to base_dir, confined to root."""
+    skip = list(skip or [])
+    skip.append(name)
+    root_real = os.path.realpath(root)
+    resolved_path = os.path.realpath(os.path.join(base_dir, name))
+    if os.path.commonpath([resolved_path, root_real]) != root_real:
+        raise IncludeError(f"include escapes the project root: {name}", 0, 1)
+    if not os.path.isfile(resolved_path):
+        raise ValueError(f"include not found: {name}")
+    return resolved_path
+
+
+def read_chained_include(base_dir: str, name: str, root: str) -> str:
+    """Return the text of a chained include."""
+    path = resolve_chained_include(base_dir, name, root)
+    fh = open(path, encoding="utf-8")
+    text = fh.read()
+    if not text.strip():
+        raise IncludeError(f"empty include: {name}", 0, 1)
+    fh.close()
+    return text
